test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six classmates L, M, N, O, P and Q compare the IGCSE results of their final exam. Each of them scored different marks. O scored more than N but less than L. M scored more than N. P scored less than N but more than Q. L scored less than M. Who among the six scored the most?
solution:
**Given:**

Six classmates L, M, N, O, P and Q compare the IGCSE results of their final exam. Each of them scored different marks.

According to given information, we have the possible arrangements as follows:

1. O scored more than N but less than L:

 L > O > N

2. P scored less than N but more than Q. L scored less than M. M scored more than N

M > L > O > N > P > Q

After combining all the arrangements, we get:

**M > L > O > N > P > Q**

 Among the six** 'M' **scored the most.
